get.description: An uploaded document with the state of each stage of its latest job.

Stage events of the latest job; ``Last-Event-ID`` replays everything after that ``seq``.

The Supabase pooler has no LISTEN/NOTIFY, so the stream polls ``job_events`` about once a
second (``jobs.poll_interval_s``) and ends after the ``done`` event.

ApiCandidate.title: ApiCandidate
ApiCandidate.description: One extractor's value for a field, as shown in the inspector.

BidClosedInfo.title: BidClosedInfo
BidClosedInfo.description: "Bid/offer closed on" as printed on the Prospectus cover (read by the extract stage).

audio.title: Audio
audio.description: webm/opus or wav, at most 20 s.

CategoryCount.title: CategoryCount
CategoryCount.description: How many risks fall in one category (the filter chips).

ChatRequest.title: ChatRequest
ChatRequest.description: ``POST /api/chat`` body: the IPO, the question and its language.

CheckResult.title: CheckResult
CheckResult.description: The result of one verifier check: verdict, reason and the values compared.

Companion.title: Companion
Companion.description: The same field read from the other document (RHP ``[●]`` beside the Prospectus value).

ComparePercentile.title: ComparePercentile
ComparePercentile.description: Where one metric of this IPO falls among past IPOs (0-100).

CostSummary.title: CostSummary
CostSummary.description: ``GET /api/admin/costs``: estimates from job wall-clock time; billing is the truth.

CostTotal.title: CostTotal
CostTotal.description: Totals over the window, with the share of the monthly free grant used.

Count.description: A whole-number count, such as a number of equity shares.
Count.title: Count

DocDetail.title: DocDetail
DocDetail.description: ``GET /api/docs/{doc_id}``: the document, its latest job and stages.

DocRecord.title: DocRecord
DocRecord.description:
One uploaded or showcase document, keyed by ``doc_id`` (B02 §5).

``doc_type``, ``company`` and ``pages`` are filled in by the ``detected`` stage, so they are
empty while the job is queued. A rejected upload keeps its ``rejection`` code.

ErrorBody.title: ErrorBody
ErrorBody.description: The error envelope's body: code, message, hint, and quota details if any.

FieldCheck.title: FieldCheck
FieldCheck.description: One verifier check on an X-Ray field, as the UI shows it.

GlossaryEntry.title: GlossaryEntry
GlossaryEntry.description: A glossary term with its short definition.

HealthResponse.title: HealthResponse
HealthResponse.description: ``GET /api/health``: status, profile, demo mode and model states.

Hedging.title: Hedging
Hedging.description: B02 §7.2: hedge words counted, and whether the risk states a past fact with a number.

IpoDetail.title: IpoDetail
IpoDetail.description: A showcase IPO's documents: page counts, page size and sections.

IpoSummary.title: IpoSummary
IpoSummary.description: A showcase IPO in the library list, with its headline sizes.

Job.title: Job
Job.description: One processing run of a document (B02 §5).

ListValue.title: ListValue
ListValue.description: A field value that is a list of strings.

ModelStatus.title: ModelStatus
ModelStatus.description: Whether one model is loaded (or loads lazily on first use).

Money.description: An amount of money with its raw text and scale word, normalised to rupees where known.
Money.title: Money

NearestExample.title: NearestExample
NearestExample.description: A similar risk from a past IPO (company, year, title, similarity).

PageEvidence.title: PageEvidence
PageEvidence.description: Where a value or risk came from: a page, optionally a box and the sentence.

PageSize.title: PageSize
PageSize.description: Page width and height in PDF points.

PageWord.title: PageWord
PageWord.description: A word on a page: text ``t`` and box ``b``.

PageWords.title: PageWords
PageWords.description: Every word on one page, for highlighting and text selection.

Peer.title: Peer
Peer.description: One row of the Basis for Offer Price peer table (B05 §5.6). ``None`` = not stated.

Percent.description: A percentage (or basis points) as a decimal string.
Percent.title: Percent

Placeholder.description: A blank the document fills in later: [●] or [•]. Never a zero.
Placeholder.title: Placeholder

Range.description: A price band or other money range with its low and high ends.
Range.title: Range

RedFlag.title: RedFlag
RedFlag.description: One of the 13 red-flag checks (B01 §5, B02 §5); ``points`` 2 concern, 1 watch, else 0.

Risk.title: Risk
Risk.description: One risk factor of a document (B02 §5); features are ``None`` until their stage runs.

RiskLevel.title: RiskLevel
RiskLevel.description: B02 §7.4: points over the checks available, placed among past IPOs (2018-2023).

RiskLevelReason.title: RiskLevelReason
RiskLevelReason.description: One reason behind the risk level: a red flag or a risk, with points and anchor.

RisksPage.title: RisksPage
RisksPage.description: ``GET /api/docs/{doc_id}/risks``: counts, the filtered risks and the queue.

SectionInfo.title: SectionInfo
SectionInfo.description: A section of a document with its PDF and printed start pages.

SimplifyQueued.title: SimplifyQueued
SimplifyQueued.description: Where a risk stands after asking for its plain-English version.

SourceSentence.title: SourceSentence
SourceSentence.description: The line of the page a value sits on; ``hit`` is the character span of the value in it.

StageState.title: StageState
StageState.description: One pipeline stage of an uploaded document, rebuilt from its events.

SuggestedQuestion.title: SuggestedQuestion
SuggestedQuestion.description: A question chip under the chat box (normal, trick or advice).

TableValue.title: TableValue
TableValue.description: A field value that is a small table.

TextValue.title: TextValue
TextValue.description: A field value that is free text.

Trace.title: Trace
Trace.description: Everything one chat answer went through, for the trace inspector.

UploadInit.title: UploadInit
UploadInit.description: ``POST /api/uploads/init`` body: file name, size and SHA-256.

UploadInitResponse.title: UploadInitResponse
UploadInitResponse.description: Either the existing report (same hash) or where to upload the file.

UploadLimits.title: UploadLimits
UploadLimits.description: What the upload page shows before anyone uploads (B05 §3).

VoiceResponse.title: VoiceResponse
VoiceResponse.description: ``POST /api/voice``: the transcript and the ASR model used.

XRayField.title: XRayField
XRayField.description: One fact of the X-Ray with its source, verdict, checks and candidates.

StageEvent.description: A chat pipeline stage starting or ending, with its time in ms.
StageEvent.title: StageEvent

FactSummary.description: A short X-Ray fact shown on the advice-refusal card.
FactSummary.title: FactSummary

GuardEvent.description: The guard's decision; when blocked, the facts shown instead of advice.
GuardEvent.title: GuardEvent

RetrievedPassage.description: One passage the retriever returned, with its rank in each method.
RetrievedPassage.title: RetrievedPassage

RetrievalEvent.description: The passages kept for the prompt and the ones dropped.
RetrievalEvent.title: RetrievalEvent

AbstainEvent.description: FinSight declines to answer because retrieval found nothing close enough.
AbstainEvent.title: AbstainEvent

TokenEvent.description: A piece of streamed answer text.
TokenEvent.title: TokenEvent

Citation.description: A ``[n]`` citation in the answer and its character span.
Citation.title: Citation

AnswerEvent.description: The full answer text with its citations, sent once streaming ends.
AnswerEvent.title: AnswerEvent

Evidence.description: Where a checked number was found: passage, page, span and box.
Evidence.title: Evidence

VerdictEvent.description: The verifier's mark for one number in the answer.
VerdictEvent.title: VerdictEvent

FinalEvent.description: The last chat event: trace id, score, number count and stage timings.
FinalEvent.title: FinalEvent

ErrorEvent.description: A chat error the UI can show (model unavailable, warming up, internal).
ErrorEvent.title: ErrorEvent

JobStageEvent.description: A document job stage starting, ending or failing (B06 §2).
JobStageEvent.title: JobStageEvent

JobProgressEvent.description: Progress inside a long stage: ``done`` of ``total`` items.
JobProgressEvent.title: JobProgressEvent

JobReadyEvent.description: A report part is ready and the UI can fetch it.
JobReadyEvent.title: JobReadyEvent

RiskSimplifiedEvent.description: A risk's plain-English rewrite finished (or was rejected or failed).
RiskSimplifiedEvent.title: RiskSimplifiedEvent

JobDoneEvent.description: The job finished: ready, partial (some stages failed) or failed.
JobDoneEvent.title: JobDoneEvent
